people.name: Nahor
people.line: Son of Serug; father of Terah, Abraham's father.

people.name: Terah
people.line: Abraham's father who settled in Haran

translations.web: Nahor lived one hundred nineteen years after he became the father of Terah, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
translations.bsb: And after he had become the father of Terah, Nahor lived 119 years and had other sons and daughters.
translations.kjv: And Nahor lived after he begat Terah an hundred and nineteen years, and begat sons and daughters.
translations.asv: and Nahor lived after he begat Terah a hundred and nineteen years, and begat sons and daughters.
